whenToUse: The same object appears in both the list and the details, such as photos or product cards.
You visually connect which item was opened.
Going back shows the original position again.
whenNotToUse: The two screens don't share an object (use a page transition).
Several elements with the same name would exist on one screen.

alternatives.name: Zoom Transition
alternatives.reason: The whole screen grows out of an icon.

accessibility: When the details open, focus goes to the close button; when they close, it returns to the photo that was pressed.
Without the API, or with reduced motion, the screen just switches without a transition.
Each photo comes with a name and a text description.
Give view-transition-name to only one element at a time.
